name: HIV Testing Locations
description:
This dataset is a directory of HIV testing locations, most likely in New York City, containing 599 sampled records with 18 fields each. Every record identifies a testing agency by name and address, and most include a borough, ZIP code, phone number, and website. The data also provides day-by-day operating hours from Monday through Sunday, though hours are missing for roughly 60 percent of records and Sunday hours are almost always listed as closed. Service details include ages served, special populations served, payment and cost information, whether free self-tests are available, and occasional additional notes such as Medicaid acceptance.

The data sits in the public health and social services domain, focused on access to HIV prevention and testing. It could support a searchable directory or map of testing sites, analysis of geographic coverage and gaps across boroughs, comparisons of operating hours and availability, and identification of locations offering free or low-cost testing. Because many fields are sparsely populated, the dataset is best suited to directory-style look
